label: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
definition: MRR x 12. A run-rate, not a forecast or a bookings number. Multi-year ramps use the CURRENT year's price.
refresh: Daily 06:00 UTC; a month locks on business day 5 after close
consumers: Board pack; Investor update; Executive KPI dashboard

label: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
definition: Contracted recurring revenue in force at month end, normalised to one month, net of recurring discounts, in constant currency. Excludes one-time services, usage overage, taxes, and free plans. Not affected by invoices or refunds.
formula: SUM(month-end mrr_local x planning FX rate) over active subscription versions
refresh: Daily 06:00 UTC; a month locks on business day 5 after close
consumers: Board pack; Executive KPI dashboard; Salesforce ARR sync

label: Net New MRR
definition: New + expansion + reactivation - contraction - churn. FX rebasing is excluded on purpose (MLR-006), so closing MRR = opening MRR + FX rebase + net new MRR.

label: Churned MRR
definition: Previous-month MRR of accounts whose MRR fell to zero. Recorded in the month the contract ends, not the month a refund is paid.

label: Contraction MRR
definition: Month-over-month MRR decrease from accounts that are still paying. Reported as a positive number.
formula: SUM(prev_mrr - mrr) where both > 0 and mrr < prev_mrr

label: Expansion MRR
definition: Month-over-month MRR increase from existing paying accounts (seats, plan upgrades, price increases).
formula: SUM(mrr - prev_mrr) where both > 0 and mrr > prev_mrr, both valued at the current planning rate

label: New MRR
definition: MRR from accounts paying for the first time this month, including free-to-paid conversions.
formula: SUM(mrr) where previous month MRR = 0 and the account has never paid before

label: Reactivation MRR
definition: MRR from previously churned accounts that start paying again. Kept separate from New MRR so win-backs do not inflate acquisition.
formula: SUM(mrr) where prev_mrr = 0 and the account paid in any earlier month

label: SaaS Quick Ratio
definition: (New + expansion + reactivation MRR) / (contraction + churned MRR). Growth efficiency; above 4 is strong.

label: Active Customers
definition: Accounts with MRR > 0 at month end. Free-plan and test accounts are never customers.

label: Gross Revenue Retention (GRR, trailing 12 months)
definition: Like NRR, but each account's current MRR is capped at its starting MRR, so expansion cannot hide churn. Always <= 100% and <= NRR.
formula: SUM(LEAST(current MRR, starting MRR)) / SUM(starting MRR)

label: Logo Churn Rate (monthly)
definition: Churned customers / customers at the start of the month. Queried at a coarser grain it returns the customer-weighted AVERAGE MONTHLY rate (sum of churned / sum of starting customers), never a compounded annual rate.
formula: churned_customers / customers paying at end of previous month
consumers: Board pack; Customer health dashboard; LTV

label: Net Revenue Retention (NRR, trailing 12 months)
definition: Current MRR of the accounts that were paying 12 months ago, divided by their MRR 12 months ago. Includes expansion, contraction, churn and win-backs inside the window; excludes accounts acquired during the window.
formula: SUM(cohort current MRR) / SUM(cohort MRR 12 months ago)
consumers: Board pack; Investor update; Customer health dashboard

label: Average Revenue per Account (ARPA)
definition: MRR / active customers at month end.

label: Churned Customers
definition: Accounts that were paying last month and are not paying this month.

label: New Customers
definition: Accounts paying for the first time this month. Denominator of CAC.

label: Retention Cohort Current MRR
definition: Current MRR of the accounts that were paying twelve months ago. Numerator of NRR.

label: Retention Cohort Retained MRR (capped)
definition: Current cohort MRR with each account capped at its starting MRR. Numerator of GRR.

label: Retention Cohort Starting MRR
definition: MRR twelve months ago of the accounts paying twelve months ago. Denominator of NRR and GRR.
formula: SUM(cohort MRR at M-12, valued at month M planning rate)

label: Starting Customers
definition: Customers paying at the end of the previous month. Denominator of logo churn rate.

label: Gross Margin %
definition: (Net revenue - COGS) / net revenue.

label: Net Revenue (recognised)
definition: Recognised revenue: ratable recurring revenue + onboarding services + usage overage, minus service credits, at actual FX rates. Annual prepayments are spread over the term. Refunds reduce revenue only when they are concessions (service credits).
formula: recognised recurring + non-recurring - service credits (actual FX)
refresh: Daily 06:00 UTC; a month locks on business day 5 after close
consumers: Board pack; Gross margin; Executive KPI dashboard

label: Total Revenue (legacy) - DEPRECATED
definition: DEPRECATED. Sum of non-void invoice amounts. It counts annual prepayments in the invoice month and ignores refunds, so it spikes in renewal months and overstates revenue. Use net_revenue for revenue and net_billings in Finance tools for cash.
consumers: Legacy Sales Ops dashboard (migration ticket METRIC-112)

label: Cost of Goods Sold
definition: Hosting, customer support and third-party API costs.

label: Customer Acquisition Cost (blended)
definition: Acquisition spend / new customers. Blended across channels; at quarter grain this is quarter spend / quarter new logos.
known_limitations: Channel-level CAC is not certified yet: spend is tagged by channel, accounts by acquisition channel, and the two taxonomies are being reconciled (METRIC-140).

label: CAC Payback (months)
definition: Months of gross-margin-adjusted new-customer MRR needed to recover CAC.

label: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
definition: ARPA x trailing-3-month gross margin % x expected lifetime, where lifetime = 1 / trailing 6-month average monthly logo churn, capped at 60 months. Point-in-time: a quarter query returns the quarter-end value.
formula: arpa x gross_margin_pct_t3m x MIN(1 / logo_churn_rate_t6m, 60)

label: LTV to CAC Ratio
definition: LTV / trailing-3-month blended CAC. Point-in-time, quarter queries return the quarter-end value.

label: Customer Acquisition Spend
definition: Sales & marketing spend aimed at winning new logos. Excludes Customer Success and other retention costs.

label: New-Customer ARPA
definition: New MRR / new customers. Component of CAC payback.

label: Monthly Active Users (rolling 28-day)
definition: Distinct users with a qualifying event in the 28 local days ending on the date. A month query returns the value on the month's last day.
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) over local dates d-27 .. d

label: Daily Active Users (DAU)
definition: Distinct users with at least one qualifying event on their LOCAL calendar day. Rolled up to a week or month it returns the average daily value.
formula: AVG over days of COUNT(DISTINCT user_id with a qualifying event on local date)
consumers: Product health dashboard; Embedded customer usage page

label: Stickiness (DAU / MAU)
definition: Average DAU over the period / 28-day MAU at period end. At day grain it is exactly DAU / MAU for that day.
